task: coverage3 playtest review: findings and fixes, Fusion C3 with the author's permanent-death policy (docs/COVERAGE3_REVIEW.md)
author: Claude
author_policy: A Disintegrate that would permanently kill an ally is weighed so that it is not used; at a genuinely high risk it is avoided entirely, whatever the circumstances. Implemented: veto at 1% risk or more, whatever the settings; below it, 100x the ally's worth; summons exempt.
